tracks.title: 招牌寫毋著 Tsiau-pâi Siá M̄-tio̍h
tracks.subject: a brother and sister at their family signboard shop in Chiayi who discover, the night before a noodle shop opens, that the two-storey sign they just hung has an extra digit in the phone number, and climb back up at midnight to repaint it while a police patrol shines a torch on them
